system: Meridian · crypto trend v3 (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP; 55/100-day breakouts + add), Binance daily, Kraken fees

windows.late: signals 2024-01-01 to the end of the data (2026-10-31)

prereg.hypothesis: Regime: the v3 edge exists only when Bitcoin is in a long-term uptrend, i.e. BTC/USDT daily close above its 200-day simple moving average on the signal day (same rule for all four coins). The 2024-26 fade is breakouts taken while BTC was below its 200-day average.
prereg.fixed: SMA length 200 and the BTC close on the signal day are fixed in advance: no other length, coin or threshold is tried.
prereg.fit: Early data (signals before 2024): in-regime R/trade > 0 and at least +0.5R a trade better than out-of-regime.
prereg.validate: Late data (signals 2024-01-01 on): in-regime R/trade > 0 with t >= 1.5 and at least +0.5R a trade better than out-of-regime.

verdict.alive: 2024-26 net R/trade > 0 with t >= 2 and both halves > 0
verdict.regimeDependent: not alive, and the hypothesis passes both the fit and the validation

luck.method: block bootstrap by signal month, 20,000 draws, seed 7

candidates.rule: Pre-registered: only when BTC > its 200-day SMA

notes: Verdict decayed: 2024-26 n  41  R/trade +1.081  t  1.44  total   44.3R  maxDD -7.2R  win 32%; first half n  21  R/trade +2.237  t  1.58  total   47.0R  maxDD -2.5R  win 43%; second half (Jun 2025 - Oct 2026) n  20  R/trade -0.133  t -0.56  total   -2.7R  maxDD -5.0R  win 20%.
Kraken candles from 2025-03-17: n  24  R/trade -0.247  t -1.32  total   -5.9R  maxDD -8.3R  win 17%. Fees cost 0.074R a position (5 ATR stop, ~23% of price).
2024-26 without its best 5% (the XRP Nov 2024 run): 0.05R a position; before 2024 the same cut leaves 1.968R.

Pre-registered rule reads regime-dependent, but in the recent half BTC-uptrend breakouts made -0.02R (n 16): the regime does not explain the fade. Bootstrap: ~10% chance of a half this bad under the old behaviour.
